opening: I have pain in my right wrist.
There's a new soft swelling on the palm side of my right wrist.
It has been going on for more than three months.
The skin over it is red and peeling.
At first I was told it was a wrist sprain.
I was given anti-inflammatory painkillers (NSAIDs) for it.
Later I was told it was osteoarthritis.
